info.title: Tophhie Cloud Universal API
info.description: Public cloud utility APIs for Microsoft Entra tenant information, identifier conversion, domain intelligence, IP checks, generated identifiers, Tophhie Cloud Blog content, and Tophhie Social public statistics.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: The IP address to query.

schema.description: The IP address to query.

parameters.name: reverseCheck
parameters.description: Whether to perform a reverse DNS lookup on the IP address.

schema.description: Whether to perform a reverse DNS lookup on the IP address.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

mapsUrl.description: Map links for the IP location.

metadata.description: Provider metadata for the IP lookup.

result.description: Queried IP address or location result.
